_comment: Combinatorial skill-lore grammar. Loaded as window.Skills.Lore by DataService. The <Lore: #School> directive on each skill note (see gen_skill_lore.py) is resolved at RUNTIME by ItemSystemUtils.fillLore, seeded from the live world seed (worldSeed() ^ skillId) so every world tells its own history. Each School supplies bespoke vocabulary banks (art/era/mechanism/attrib); each family is a distinct sentence-generation algorithm (tone + templates). Keep additions grammatical: art=bare noun phrase, era=temporal appositive, mechanism=participial clause, attrib=noun phrase for people/peoples.
